_doc: Plan 116: level-gated deadline sentences kept from official notice Detail pages ('reach Lv N by <date>', 'enrol by'). Each pattern is a case-insensitive Python regex searched in one sentence; an optional named group 'level' picks the level, else the sentence's only 'Lv N' / 'Level N' (two different levels: conf x 0.8). A sentence is kept only when it also holds a date that resolves. conf at or over the plan 111 gate (0.95) adds the row with by notice; below it the row is a suggestion only. Estimated wording, not measured against a live notice yet.
